issue: Mentioning a user in a task comment with different capitalisation, e.g. '@Bob' instead of '@bob', does not notify them and they are not recorded as mentioned. Mentions should be case-insensitive.

ground_truth.root_cause: normalize_handle no longer lower-cases the handle, so find_by_handle compares 'Bob' with the stored lower-case handle 'bob' and finds nobody; comments resolve mentions through find_by_handle.
